artifacts.title: General Assembly power to give directions to SJC on judicial decisions

matches.evidence: The CCB found an overture allowing the Assembly to direct SJC judicial reasoning was in conflict with the Constitution, because a commission concludes business as the court itself under BCO 15.

artifacts.title: Overture to abolish the Standing Judicial Commission

matches.evidence: The CCB found the overture to abolish the SJC in conflict with BCO 14-1 and 15, and also unconstitutionally vague about the basis for alternative decisions.
